notes.title: 🚀 Space Drop: Update Alert!
notes.content:
Galactic adventure lovers, listen up! We are excited to introduce our latest update for Space Drop – a step towards an even better gaming experience in the vastness of space! We have worked hard to enhance the player experience and offer new content. Here’s what you can expect:

✨ What’s New?

[list]
[*] [b]Updated Scene Switch Fading:[/b] Enjoy smoother and more visually appealing transitions between scenes that make your adventure even more immersive!
[*] [b]Added Additional Achievement:[/b] Challenge yourself! We’ve added a new achievement that will test your skills in the game. Are you ready to earn it?
[*] [b]Corrected Base Shields in Two Levels:[/b] We’ve improved the performance of the shields to keep you safer in the intense action.
[*] [b]Fixed Some Localizations:[/b] We want to ensure that you can enjoy the game in your preferred language, so we’ve fixed some localization errors.
[*] [b]Fixed Releasing of Game Objects:[/b] To ensure a safer and smoother gameplay experience, we’ve implemented some necessary fixes.
[*] [b]Updated Credits:[/b] A big thanks to our fantastic team – you’ll find our updated credits in the game!
[/list]

🌟 [b]Join the Adventure![/b] These updates are part of our commitment to continuously improve [b]Space Drop[/b] and provide all players with an exciting experience. If you appreciate new features and improvements, it’s time to launch your spaceship and dive into the adventure!

Thank you for your support and for playing [b]Space Drop[/b]! We’re excited to hear your feedback and look forward to bringing you more intergalactic news.

Stay tuned for future updates, and seize the chance for the next level – your space adventure awaits! 🌠

notes.title: 🚀 Discover the new tutorial and the expanded levels in Space Drop!
notes.content:
Thank you for your valuable feedback! We have listened to your suggestions and are excited to announce that the tutorial has been revamped and expanded into four distinct parts:

[list]
[*] Control Tutorial
[*] Laser & HUD Tutorial
[*] Obstacle Tutorial
[*] PickUp Tutorial
[/list]

Additionally, we have added new levels, bringing the total to 24 exciting levels across four difficulty settings: Easy, Medium, Hard, and Ultra.

Just like in every sport, where advertisements line the tracks and fields, you can now find them on the Warp Tunnel Race Track as well! These ads add a touch of realism to your racing experience, immersing you further into the thrilling world of Space Drop.

notes.title: Additional translations
notes.content:
Feature:
- Added additional languages (Spanish, French, Italian)

Bugfixes:
- Fixed Tutorial

notes.title: Take Your Skills Further – New Levels, Controls, and Ultra Mode!
notes.content:
[h1]Are you ready to take on the ultimate VR challenge in Space Drop?[/h1]

We’re thrilled to introduce our first major update, packed with improvements inspired by your feedback!

[b]What’s New:[/b]

[list]
[*] Completely revamped game UI for a smoother experience
[*] Fresh new levels to test your skills
[*] Enhanced level-end screens
[*] Earn stars for achieving specific goals in each level
[*] New "Ultra" difficulty mode for the brave
[*] Improved firing accuracy and warp tunnel collision feedback
[*] Expanded control options for a more personalized setup
[*] Optimized performance for a seamless playthrough
[/list]

Thank you for helping us make Space Drop even better – dive in and enjoy the latest thrills!

notes.title: Get Ready to Jump into the Future with "Space Drop" - Available Now!
notes.content:
Hello Space Jumpers!

We are thrilled to announce that "Space Drop" is now available on Steam! Get ready to experience the ultimate sci-fi VR adventure that will take you on a breathtaking journey through the cosmos.

About Space Drop:

In "Space Drop," you step into the boots of elite Space Jumpers, the skydivers of the future, navigating warp tunnels with unmatched speed and precision. Equipped with advanced suits and boosters, you will race through visually stunning environments, dodge intricate obstacles, and collect valuable power-ups. Your goal? To become the best Space Jumper in the galaxy!

Key Features:

Immersive VR Experience: Feel the adrenaline rush as you leap from spaceships into warp tunnels, designed to deliver a fully immersive VR experience.
Innovative Gameplay: Test your reflexes and skills as you evade obstacles and gather power-ups to enhance your performance.
Achievements and Leaderboards: Compete with players worldwide to claim the top spots on the leaderboards and unlock a variety of achievements.

Join Us on This Cosmic Adventure:

We invite you to dive into "Space Drop" and experience the most thrilling VR adventure of the year. Whether you're dodging obstacles at breakneck speeds or designing your own challenging levels, there's endless fun to be had.

Your feedback is invaluable to us. Please share your thoughts, ideas, and any issues you encounter. We are committed to making "Space Drop" an incredible experience for all our players.

Thank You for Your Support!

We couldn't have made it this far without the support of our amazing community. So, suit up, jump in, and let's conquer the galaxy together!

Happy Jumping!

The Space Drop Team

notes.title: Release version update for July 12, 2024
notes.content:
We are looking forward to the release of “Space Drop” on July 12, 2024. We have already uploaded the final version to Steam, so we can start right away on Friday.

We have also updated the demo version.

notes.title: Tutorial & UI Update
notes.content: We released the new update. It contains a brand new tutorial and overhauled UI.

notes.title: Updated Demo with Mines and new Levels
notes.content:
We have been working on the game. The new demo includes mines and new levels.
This gives the player a new challenge and a new experience.

We also updated the control settings. You are now able to switch between using both hands or a single hand for playing.
If you only use one hand, you can enable automatic boost without pressing a button.

notes.title: Space Drop Livestream
notes.content:
Can you become the best "Space Jumper" in the universe? Jump out of a spaceship into a warp tunnel. Feel the thrill of the high speed. Evade obstacles and collect pickups on your way.

[list]
[*] Jump out of a spaceship into a warp tunnel
[*] Get the highest score by collecting pickups and evading obstacles
[*] Unique music
[/list]

[h2]Plot Summary[/h2]

2142, New Earth

In the sprawling metropolis of New Earth, a technological marvel forged from the remnants of a once-dying planet, the air buzzes with anticipation. The year has dawned with the announcement of the prestigious "Universe Space Jumper Championship," an event that has captured the imaginations of billions across the galaxy. Every renowned and aspiring "Space Jumper" is poised to converge for an exhilarating display of skill, courage, and sheer determination.

You, an ambitious and untested newcomer, stand on the precipice of destiny. With the echoes of legends and the weight of dreams pushing you forward, you must prove yourself worthy of the galaxy's gaze. As the preliminary rounds loom, the thrum of your heart matches the hum of the engines that will propel you into the unknown.

With your adrenaline pumping, you immerse yourself in the diverse tracks set across the universe, each one a treacherous blend of cosmic challenges.

Your quest for victory is not merely for personal glory; it becomes a symbol of hope for a civilization grappling with its past and reaching for a brighter future.

Only by surpassing your limits, embracing the unknown, and defying the odds can you emerge as the ultimate Space Jumper, etching your name in the annals of history and inspiring generations to come.

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]

[list]
[*] Control your jump with vr controllers
[*] Full VR experience
[*] Fixed levels: Competition, Leaderboards, Awards, Achievements
[*] Level editor: Create your own levels and share them with the community
[*] Random levels: Endless fun in random generated levels
[*] Inspired by sky diving
[/list]
